subject: Control System
questionText:
Four systems A, B, C and D are found to have the
dominant poles at the points –2 +j6, –3+ j6, –10+ j2, –
4 + j8 respectively. The choice of the system having
maximum damping and minimum natural frequency
would be
(a)
C and A respectively
(b)
B and C respectively
(c)
C and D respectively
(d)
A and C respectively
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-06 (Time Response Analysis (Part-3&4)).
